salestaxtab.everywhereYouCollectSalesTax.en:
Everywhere you collect sales tax — state, county, city, special district.
          Tag invoices with a jurisdiction and this page tells you what you owe, where.
salestaxtab.everywhereYouCollectSalesTax.draft:
Svugdje gdje naplaćujete porez na promet — država, okrug, grad, posebni distrikt.
          Označite fakture jurisdikcijom i ova stranica vam govori što dugujete i gdje.

salestaxtab.noJurisdictionsYetAddTheFirs.en: No jurisdictions yet. Add the first place you collect sales tax.
salestaxtab.noJurisdictionsYetAddTheFirs.draft: Još nema jurisdikcija. Dodajte prvo mjesto gdje naplaćujete porez na promet.

salestaxtab.ofSalesTaxIsnTTagged.en:
of sales tax isn't tagged to a jurisdiction yet.
            Tag invoices with a jurisdiction so every dollar lands in the right bucket.
salestaxtab.ofSalesTaxIsnTTagged.draft:
poreza na promet još nije označeno jurisdikcijom.
            Označite fakture jurisdikcijom kako bi svaki dolar završio u pravoj ladici.

teaminvites.inviteYourAccountantOrTaxPro.en:
Invite your accountant or tax pro — they join with the right permissions
        and can switch between all the workspaces they serve.
teaminvites.inviteYourAccountantOrTaxPro.draft:
Pozovite svog računovođu ili poreznog stručnjaka — pridružuje se s pravim dozvolama
        i može se prebacivati između svih radnih prostora koje opslužuje.

cpapackage.mileageLogWithIRSRatesApplied.en: Mileage log with IRS rates applied
cpapackage.mileageLogWithIRSRatesApplied.draft: Evidencija kilometraže s primijenjenim IRS stopama

customers.deleteConfirm.en: Delete customer "{{name}}"? Their invoices and statements stay on record.
customers.deleteConfirm.draft: Izbrisati kupca „{{name}}“? Njegove fakture i izvodi ostaju u evidenciji.

payroll.partnershipStubWhenAProviderIs.en: Partnership stub: when a provider is connected, runs here will hand off tax filing and direct deposit automatically.
payroll.partnershipStubWhenAProviderIs.draft: Nacrt partnerstva: kada se poveže pružatelj, obračuni će ovdje automatski predavati porezne prijave i izravne uplate.

tax.inTheRepoNoIRSFiling.en: in the repo. No IRS filing is ever done in-house.
tax.inTheRepoNoIRSFiling.draft: u repozitoriju. IRS prijava se nikada ne podnosi interno.

tax.recipientBox1DataShapedFor.en: Recipient + Box 1 data shaped for e-filing. Tax IDs stay masked — reveal needs PII access. Draft data only, nothing is filed in-house.
tax.recipientBox1DataShapedFor.draft: Podaci o primatelju + polje 1 oblikovani za e-prijavu. Porezni ID-jevi ostaju maskirani — otkrivanje zahtijeva pristup osobnim podacima. Samo nacrt podataka, ništa se ne prijavljuje interno.

tax.eGMarchBoothRentPayout.draft: npr. Isplata najma mjesta za ožujak

tax.thisDraftLivesInTaxBanditsReview.en: This draft lives in TaxBandits — review and Transmit there to file with the IRS. This app never files in-house.
tax.thisDraftLivesInTaxBanditsReview.draft: Ovaj nacrt živi u TaxBanditsu — pregledajte i prenesite tamo za prijavu IRS-u. Ova aplikacija nikada ne prijavljuje interno.

tax.NECIsRequiredForNon.en: 1099-NEC is required for non-corporate contractors paid ≥
tax.NECIsRequiredForNon.draft: 1099-NEC je obavezan za nekorporativne izvođače plaćene ≥

tax.inTheYearEFilingCreates.en: in the year. E-filing creates a draft in TaxBandits — you review and transmit there. This app never files with the IRS directly.
tax.inTheYearEFilingCreates.draft: u godini. E-prijava stvara nacrt u TaxBanditsu — pregledavate i prenosite tamo. Ova aplikacija nikada ne prijavljuje izravno IRS-u.
